implemented_claims: First-class local oya gate validate cloud-iac-cell-topology dispatcher, usage, run-all, and lane-catalog registration.
Repo-local microservices/cloud-iac/cell-topology/foundation.json topology artifact for five contexts/cells.
Manifest cell_topology_scope truth-down with explicit local-only runtime_mode, contexts, regions, module refs, non-claims, and coherence guard.

Gate checks topology/manifest/catalog/template coherence, default_cross_cell_traffic_allowed=false, catalog-backed module refs, repo-relative template paths, sorted summaries, duplicate cells, and credential-like evidence markers.
explicit_non_claims: No autosharding, auto-rebalance, dynamic sharding, tenant migration, or audit-chain automation execution.
No Argo CD API, Kubernetes API, repository credential, live sync, diff, health, prune, self-heal, rollout, rollback, or cosign verification execution.
No OpenTofu CLI execution, tofu init/validate/test/plan/apply, provider lockfile, provider API, or cloud resource provisioning.
No REST/SDK/worker runtime adapters, measured SLO, active-active DR, live mesh enforcement, capacity telemetry, or hyperscaler readiness claim.
false_green_findings_closed: Manifest previously advertised cell-topology-plan-metadata but had no machine-readable topology artifact or first-class gate.
The new gate prevents topology done markers unless contexts/regions/cells/module refs/template paths/non-claims remain coherent with source artifacts.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not green because of unrelated/concurrent repository blockers: oya-vcs-admission reports four app-shell evidence files missing audit-chain coverage, and ADR-shape still fails on pre-existing ADR-0322..ADR-0349 section-shape diagnostics.
Cell topology remains local metadata only and does not satisfy ADR-0348 sharding automation execution requirements.
Provider lockfiles, signed module index, OpenTofu validation/test/plan/apply, private module registry API, and live Argo CD reconciliation evidence remain future Cloud IaC slices.

Command has live-path defaults and aggregate diagnostics.

Focused tests, live gate, module/GitOps regressions, scoped check/clippy/fmt, JSON parsing, dependency-seam, scoped honest/retired, default run-all 84/84, and full verifier D-1/D-2/D-3/D-4/D-6 pass; full verifier remains red only on unrelated app-shell evidence admission and pre-existing ADR-shape blockers.
Deferred live sharding/Argo/OpenTofu integration because current evidence supports only local topology metadata.
Rejects secret-like evidence markers and keeps provider/API/credential surfaces as non-claims.
No runtime hot path; local scan is bounded to five cells and catalog/template files.

findings: Correctness: parser, manifest guard, topology JSON checks, catalog-backed module refs, template-path checks, run-all registration, and negative tests align with the local evidence-gate objective.
Readability: one gate module follows existing oya-dev-cli local gate style; helpers are explicit and diagnostics are concrete.
Architecture: no new dependencies; gate remains local filesystem/JSON validation and preserves clean separation from runtime provider/OpenTofu/Argo surfaces.
Security: rejects secret-like markers and keeps credentials/provider/runtime surfaces as non-claims.
Performance: bounded local validation over small JSON/catalog/template surfaces; no hot-path runtime code.
scope_notes: This is intentionally not a live sharding/topology controller.
The topology artifact is metadata evidence for local coherence only; follow-up slices must add provider locks, OpenTofu validation, signing, and live reconciliation evidence separately.
